reviewMethod: Actually and independently read all 200 complete frozen entries in eight untruncated ranges of 25 (1-25 through 176-200). Each output contained every frozen term, POS, complete Chinese meaning, every variant/source, rank and every lexical-evidence field, followed by the complete five-field authored row or the full individual authoring deferral. All 93 English/Chinese pairs and all 107 authoring reasons were read, not sampled. Independently assessed exact head/inflection, selected sense, POS/function, register, naturalness and translation. Author lexical notes were auxiliary only; independently checked selected rare/technical uses against actual publisher definitions and scoped original research/publisher extracts. Raw TSV, LOCK, entire frozen queue, entire compiled source bytes and pack-scoped deferrals all still equal the immutable initial snapshots. Current compiled entries exactly equal the five authored fields and order. The 93 authored terms and 107 deferred terms are disjoint and account for all 200 candidates. No known blocking linguistic issue found; this is not approval of the 107 deferred candidates or a claim to have read entire linked research papers.
